# Library/Packages
```{r}
library(graphics)
library(rio)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stats)
library(aTSA)
library(MASS)
library(car)
```

# Data dan Eksplorasi Awal
```{r}
data<-read.csv("D:/Kuliah/Semester 5/Metode Peramalan Deret Waktu/SN_d_tot_V2.0.csv", sep=";")
colnames(data)<-c("Tahun", "Bulan", "Hari", "Desimal", "Sunspot", "SD", "Obs", "Def")
data<- subset(data, Tahun > 1926 | (Tahun == 1926 & Bulan >= 1))
data
```
```{r}
summary(data$Sunspot)
```
```{r}
colSums(is.na(data))
```
```{r}
plot(data$Desimal, data$Sunspot, 
     type = "l", col = "gray50", 
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Sunspot", 
     main = "Plot Data Mentah Sunspot (1926 - 2026)")
```
```{r}
data_bulanan <- aggregate(Sunspot ~ Tahun + Bulan, data = data, FUN = mean)
data_bulanan <- data_bulanan[order(data_bulanan$Tahun, data_bulanan$Bulan), ]
ts_bulanan <- ts(data_bulanan$Sunspot, start = c(1926, 1), frequency = 12)
ts_bulanan
```

```{r}
plot(ts_bulanan, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Bulanan Sunspot (Januari 1926 - September 2026)")
```
```{r}
data_tahunan <- aggregate(Sunspot ~ Tahun, data = data, FUN = mean)
ts_tahunan <- ts(data_tahunan$Sunspot, start = 1926, frequency = 1)
plot(ts_tahunan, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Tahunan Sunspot (Januari 1926 - September 2026)")
```
```{r}
dec_sunspot <- decompose(ts_bulanan, type = "additive")
plot(dec_sunspot)
```
```{r}
monthplot(ts_bulanan, ylab = "Sunspot (ppm)", col = "darkblue", 
          main = "Monthplot Data Sunspot")
```
```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = as.factor(Tahun), y = Sunspot)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "orange", color = "black", outlier.size = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, size = 8)) +
  labs(title = "Sebaran Sunspot Bulanan per Tahun",
       x = "Tahun",
       y = "Jumlah Sunspot")
```
```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = Bulan, y = Sunspot, group = Tahun, color = Tahun)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) + 
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Pola Musiman Sunspot (1926 - 2026)",
       x = "Bulan (1-12)",
       y = "Jumlah Sunspot")
```

# Pembagian Training dan Testing Data
```{r}
ts_sunspot<-ts_tahunan
n_total <- length(ts_sunspot)
n_test <- 20
n_train <- n_total - n_test

train_data <- window(ts_sunspot, end = time(ts_sunspot)[n_train])
test_data <- window(ts_sunspot, start = time(ts_sunspot)[n_train + 1])
```
```{r}
plot(train_data, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Training")
```
```{r}
plot(test_data, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Testing")
```

```{r}
min(train_data)
```


# Uji Stasioneritas
## Uji Fligner-Killeen
```{r}
data$Periode <- cut(data$Tahun, 
                         breaks = c(1925, 1950, 1975, 2000, 2026), 
                         labels = c("1926-1950", "1951-1975", "1976-2000", "2001-2026"))

fligner.test(Sunspot ~ Periode, data = data)
```
## Uji ADF
```{r}
adf.test(train_data)
```
# Penanganan Ragam Tidak Stasioner
```{r}
train_log <- log(train_data)
test_log <- log(test_data)

plot.ts(train_log, type="l", col="black", main="Plot Data Log(Sunspot)")
```
```{r}
aTSA::adf.test(train_log)
```
```{r}
df_log <- data.frame(
  Tahun = as.numeric(time(train_log)),
  Sunspot_Log = as.numeric(train_log)
)

df_log$Periode <- cut(df_log$Tahun, 
                      breaks = 4, 
                      labels = c("Periode 1", "Periode 2", "Periode 3", "Periode 4"))

fligner.test(Sunspot_Log ~ Periode, data = df_log)
```

# Identifikasi Komponen Non-Seasonal dan Seasonal
## ACF
```{r}
acf(train_log, lag.max = 55)
```

## PACF
```{r}
pacf(train_log, lag.max = 55)
```
Tanpa differencing karena stasioner dalam rataan (d=0) dan (D=0). PACF cut off, indikasi AR(2). ACF tails off, indikasi AR (p=2 atau p=3). Tidak ada indikasi MA (q=0). ACF turun perlahan di lag musiman dan kelipatannya, indikasi Seasonal AR (P=1), (s=11),(Q=0)
# Seasonal (ga dipakai)
## Differencing
```{r}
D1 <- diff(train_data, lag = 11) 
```

## ACF setelah differencing musiman
```{r}
acf(D1, lag.max = 33, main = "ACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 11")
```
over-differencing
## PACF setelah differencing
```{r}
pacf(D1, lag.max = 33, main = "PACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 11")
```

# Kandidat Model
```{r}
model1<-arima(train_log, order = c(3, 0, 0), seasonal = list(order = c(1, 0, 0), period = 11))
model2<-arima(train_log, order = c(2, 0, 0), seasonal = list(order = c(1, 0, 0), period = 11))
model3<-arima(train_log, order = c(3, 0, 0), seasonal = list(order = c(0, 0, 1), period = 11))
model4<-arima(train_log, order = c(3, 0, 0), seasonal = list(order = c(1, 0, 1), period = 11))
model5<-arima(train_log, order = c(3, 0, 0))
model6<-arima(train_log, order = c(2, 0, 0))
```

```{r}
c(Model1_AR3_SAR1 = AIC(model1), 
  Model2_AR2_SAR1 = AIC(model2), 
  Model3_AR3_SMA1 = AIC(model3), 
  Model4_AR3_SAR1_SMA1 = AIC(model4),
  Model5_AR3 = AIC(model5),
  Model6_AR2 = AIC(model6))
```
# Pendugaan Parameter
```{r}
lmtest::coeftest(model1)
```
```{r}
lmtest::coeftest(model2)
```
```{r}
lmtest::coeftest(model3)
```
```{r}
lmtest::coeftest(model4)
```

# Diagnostik Model
## Visual
```{r}
sisaan <- residuals(model2)
plot(sisaan, main = "Data Log(Sunspot)", ylab = "Log", xlab = "Tahun")
acf(sisaan, main = "ACF", lag.max = 55)
pacf(sisaan, main = "PACF", lag.max = 55)
```
```{r}
car::qqPlot(sisaan)
plot(c(1:length(sisaan)),sisaan)
acf(sisaan)
pacf(sisaan)
```
## Uji Formal
### Sisaan menyebar normal
```{r}
ks.test(sisaan,"pnorm")
```
```{r}
shapiro.test(sisaan)
```
```{r}
nortest::ad.test(sisaan)
```
Sisaan tidak menyebar normal

### Sisaan saling bebas
```{r}
Box.test(sisaan, type = "Ljung") 
```
Sisaan saling bebas

### Sisaan memiliki ragam homogen
```{r}
Box.test((sisaan)^2, type = "Ljung")  
```
### Nilai harapan sama dengan nol
```{r}
t.test(sisaan, mu = 0, conf.level = 0.95) 
```
Nilai tengah sisaan sama dengan nol.

# Overfitting
## Part 1
```{r}
overfit_ar <- arima(train_log, order = c(3, 0, 0), seasonal = list(order = c(1, 0, 0), period = 11))
overfit_ma <- arima(train_log, order = c(2, 0, 1), seasonal = list(order = c(1, 0, 0), period = 11))
overfit_sar <- arima(train_log, order = c(2, 0, 0), seasonal = list(order = c(2, 0, 0), period = 11))
overfit_sma <- arima(train_log, order = c(2, 0, 0), seasonal = list(order = c(1, 0, 1), period = 11))
```
```{r}
c(Model_Awal = AIC(model2),
```

# Forecasting
```{r}
panjang_test <- length(test_data) 
ramalan_log <- predict(overfit_ma, n.ahead = panjang_test)
aktual_asli <- as.numeric(test_data)
prediksi_asli <- as.numeric(exp(ramalan_log$pred)) 

nilai_max <- max(c(aktual_asli, prediksi_asli), na.rm = TRUE)

plot(aktual_asli, type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 2,
     main = "Perbandingan Aktual vs Peramalan Sunspot",
     ylab = "Jumlah Sunspot", xlab = "Tahun (Data Uji)",
     ylim = c(0, nilai_max + 30))

lines(x = 1:length(prediksi_asli), y = prediksi_asli, col = "blue", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

legend("topright", legend = c("Aktual", "Prediksi Model"),
       col = c("black", "blue"), lty = c(1, 2), lwd = 2)
```
```{r}
error <- aktual_asli - prediksi_asli
rmse <- sqrt(mean(error^2))
mae <- mean(abs(error))
mape <- mean(abs(error / aktual_asli)) * 100

cat("Hasil Evaluasi Peramalan:\n")
cat("RMSE :", rmse, "\n")
cat("MAE  :", mae, "\n")
cat("MAPE :", mape, "%\n")
```
